description.narrative:
Danish contribution to the CERF for 2020-2022 + 2023
These grant allocations contributes to meeting the CERF objectives of providing fast and strategic funding for responses to emerging or escalating crises and for addressing critical funding gaps in underfunded emergencies. It will contribute to providing e.g. protection, shelter, critical health care, water and sanitation, food and nutrition for people affected by conflict, climate-related disasters, disease outbreaks and other drivers of humanitarian needs. It will also contribute to more timely, effective and efficient humanitarian action in crises situations.

OCHA is part of the UN secretariat and has a key role as global coordinator of humanitarian action. OCHA's vision is a world that comes together to help crisis-affected people rapidly get the humanitarian assistance and protection they need. OCHO's mission is to coordinate the global emergency response to save lives and protect people in humanitarian crises and to advocate for effective and principled humanitarian action. Due to the nature of the organization, operational results are general and highly aggregated and the MFA contribution is thus reflected in the overall results reporting by the partner. Please refer to this hyperlink: https://cerf.un.org/about-us/publications
